notes: One entry per version of the assistant that was benchmarked, oldest first (the first is the baseline of `bleep-agent eval compare`). `benchmark` is the run folder, relative to the repository root. Add an entry when you benchmark a new version, with what changed since the previous one.

versions.name: First implementation
changes: Baseline: the assistant as it was at the first full benchmark (6 skills, 187 cases)
A bad knob value (for example scale 'Minor') is returned to the model as a retryable tool error instead of ending the run

versions.name: Quick Wins
changes: New set_muted op, so the assistant can unmute a module (set_node_data refuses 'muted')
Embedded sample data is left out of the board snapshot (boards with a sample were refused as too large)
Prompts: the board is in the instructions, no more get_patch calls
Panels are rearranged, never trimmed: propose_panel refuses to drop wired knobs
'Minor', 'Aeolian' and 'Ionian' are read as the scale they mean
Benchmark checks fixed: curly apostrophes, any LFO waveform jack, design needs only source to output

versions.name: Motif tiling & lean lookups
changes: set_pattern tiles a short motif to the requested length and takes variations; compose prompt asks for a motif and ties for held notes
describe_module lists each knob on one line (30-40% smaller)
Prompt carries a jacks-and-knobs sheet for the 12 most used modules, so fewer lookup rounds
OpenAI prompt_cache_key per skill; results record provider-cached tokens and the report prices them

versions.name: Lean tools & citations
changes: Each skill is offered only the tools it uses: no get_patch/get_selection (the board and the selection are in the instructions), docs tools only in docs, list_module_types in patch/design, trace_signal in patch/diagnose
Tool schemas slimmed (titles and null unions removed): tool definitions 25-58% smaller per skill
set_pattern: length is required, so a short motif is always tiled
Docs tools return ready cite_as links; the docs prompt tells the model to end with them
build_panel completes an envelope section with all four stages (attack, decay, sustain, release)
Benchmark checks changed: fx_before_output accepts the effects on any signal path into the output, docs-24 accepts the publishing page (those cases are not strictly comparable with versions 1-3)

versions.name: Flow layout
changes: Modules the assistant adds are placed by code (layout.py) from their cables: flow runs left to right on the preset grid (columns 300 apart, rows 220 apart)
Voices are row blocks in the same columns, stacked under each other; envelopes and LFOs hang under their voice; a mixer sits right of the voices it mixes
Nothing is put on top of another module; existing modules are pushed right (move_node) when a new one needs the room; modules the model moved itself stay
Prompt: layout guidelines (same chain order per voice, one audio-mixer for several voices, effects in line, move_module only on request); add_module's near is only a hint
New benchmark check 'layout' (no overlaps, at least 90% of the cables touching new modules run left to right) on 20 design and 34 patch cases
